scenes.text: Watch and read: Ama asks: You are reading “We went to the market.” aloud. What helps you read smoothly?
The answer is: Read accurately at a steady pace. Reading fluency includes accuracy, pacing and expression.
Watch and read: Ama asks: When reading “We went to the market.” why should you notice the punctuation?
The answer is: It guides your expression and pauses. Punctuation helps reading sound meaningful.
